title: UI steps
description: A page-record steps file written by a model from a recording of a component's idle state, ready to record the original and judge a rebuild with.

model.description: The model that wrote the states.

steps.description: The steps file. url, target, viewport, and colorScheme come from the recording. states starts with idle, which has no actions.

notes.description: What each state shows and why its timing is what it is.

costUsd.description: Model spend for this call. 0 on a cache hit.
